item.dc:creator: Harrison Tippet

item.title: Police execute search warrants in veteran report fraud investigation
item.description: Officers searched the home of Josh Tinning, whose company provided medical and psychiatric assessments for veterans to submit as evidence for compensation payouts. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Elise Worthington

item.title: Zelenskyy says Trump's decision to take Russia's side is 'painful'
item.description: The US president is openly calling for Volodymyr Zelenskyy to be replaced and for sanctions on Russian diesel. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Builder chosen for Hobart's Macquarie Point stadium
item.description: The company that built a 30,000-seat arena in Christchurch, New Zealand, is understood to have won the tender to construct Hobart's new roofed stadium. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Chris Rowbottom

item.title: From Scotland to Tasmania, tiny town welcomes new GP
item.description: A tiny Tasmanian town's first local GP in nine years has arrived, all the way from Scotland. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Sandy Powell

item.title: In NAZA, IDF soldiers detail mass killings in their own words
item.description: Israeli filmmakers Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor have been exiled from their home country over their documentary, NAZA, which features IDF personnel detailing systematic slaughter. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Velvet Winter

item.title: ParaMatildas hunt more Australian football history at World Cup
item.description: Having won Australia's first-ever round ball World Cup in 2024, the ParaMatildas begin the 2026 tournament in uncharted territory for an Australian football team and with the world's best "plotting" against them. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Henry Hanson

item.title: The 'huge problem' Saudi Arabia faces in its conflict with the Houthis
item.description: The Houthis are trying to increase their leverage against Saudi Arabia while the kingdom is reportedly finding it harder to defend against attacks. It presents a "huge problem" in the conflict. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Matthew Doran

item.title: Firmus' IPO may have flopped but one state leader still sees 'opportunity'
item.description: Some say Firmus' money-raising venture last week reflects badly on the fledgling data centre builder, but it appears there's at least one Australian leader who has confidence in the venture — Tasmania's premier. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Lucy MacDonald

item.title: Alleged Chinese spies targeted former premier and AFP commander via LinkedIn
item.description: The same alleged Chinese spying network at the centre of Australia's first conviction for reckless foreign interference approached more than 100 people linked to Australia, including a former state premier, a police commander and several federal government officials. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Echo Hui and Meghna Bali

item.title: Five artworks to see at 15 Artists exhibition at Redcliffe Art Gallery
item.description: The invitation-only exhibition showcases some of the best and brightest early- to mid-career artists in Queensland. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Christine Flatley

item.title: It's 'the vibe': Does McDonald's ruin a town?
item.description: Communities around Australia have fought to keep the fast-food giant out of their towns for various reasons. What happens when they lose? Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Rhiannon Stevens

item.title: Death puts spotlight on 'promise' to ban ambulance ramping
item.description: A man's death following a lack of available ambulances has put the spotlight on a Tasmanian Liberal's election promise. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Ashleigh Barraclough

item.title: New Zealand couple turns old school into a home with a twist
item.description: After acquiring a rundown school in Tokanui, Ian and Sue Rogers dedicated years and around NZ$250,000 to revitalize the property, successfully turning it into a beloved family residence. They maintained many of the school’s original features, which highlight its rich history. They even converted a damaged swimming pool into a delightful chalet. Eager for their next venture, the couple has decided against tackling another school renovation. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
item.dc:creator: TOI Real Estate Desk

item.title: Scientists establish new genus of deep-sea 'spaghetti worms'
item.description: Scientists have announced a new genus of deep-sea segmented marine "spaghetti worms" with suction cups on their bodies, showing just how much undiscovered biodiversity is out there in the deep seas around Australia. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Free abortion pledge if Labor re-elected in Victoria next month
item.description: Victoria would provide free abortion care if Premier Ben Carroll is re-elected, with a politically charged plan to provide better care for women in regional and rural communities. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: What if you could turn off your algorithm? Australia is about to try
item.description: New legislation is being tabled in Australia's parliament on Thursday to force big tech to allow users to switch off algorithms which send them recommended content. Fuente: BBC News - World.

item.title: Chalmers and Frydenberg have more in common than they like to admit
item.description: Delivering reform is proving more difficult by the day. Labor has to go back to the drawing board on its plan to remove the more generous private health insurance rebate for over-65s. That's a $3 billion savings measure up in the air. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: David Speers

item.title: This strange sea animal is on menus, but it is disappearing from our reefs
item.description: A new study shows one species of sea cucumber lives much longer than previously thought, putting it at even more risk of being eaten to death by humans. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Peter de Kruijff

item.title: The latest tactic in Australia's illegal tobacco trade is hiding in plain sight
item.description: As Labor seeks support for tougher tobacco laws, new intelligence reveals how offshore factories are making illegal cigarettes look like genuine Australian products. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Clare Armstrong

item.title: Investing bonanza as younger Australians lean on AI advice
item.description: The ASX said a record 11.5 million Australian adults now hold investments outside traditional superannuation and their main home. Emerging trends include taking AI advice, investing in crypto and the doubling of ETF ownership. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: David Taylor

item.title: Indian-origin man in Australia denied bail for 'stalking' woman he met on dating app; judge says risk to her safety 'too great'
item.description: Fuente: The Times of India - World.
item.dc:creator: Gokul Ankari

item.title: Australia's oldest underwater archaeology reveals ancient life within a lost landscape
item.description: New discoveries from Australia's oldest known underwater archaeological record reveal how First Peoples lived, transported goods and used different places within a vast cultural landscape that was submerged when rising seas transformed the continent after the last ice age. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Russell Brand was ruthless, calculated and manipulative sexual predator, court told
item.description: Comedian faces three charges of rape, three of sexual assault and one of indecent assault against six women Russell Brand rape and sexual assault trial – latest updates Russell Brand was a ruthless, calculated and manipulative sexual predator who boasted about wanting to have sex with 5,000 women, a court has heard. The 51-year-old comedian is alleged to have had an “insatiable desire” to get what he wanted and treated women as a means to an end, jurors were told. Continue reading... Publicado también por: ABC News Australia. Fuente: The Guardian - World.
item.dc:creator: Emine Sinmaz

item.title: How shark ecotourism sparks long-term conservation
item.description: People who join shark ecotourism tours are more likely to take action to protect sharks, including donating to related causes, signing petitions or speaking up online, new research from the University of Sydney shows. Fuente: Phys.org.
